idea.title: Ventilador para no topete
idea.text: lanchonete em BH: ele sobe na ponta dos pés e o ventilador de teto para seco no topete

script.title: Ventilador para no topete
script.premise: Numa lanchonete de esquina em BH, Gersinho faz o passo brega embaixo do ventilador de teto; no tempo forte sobe na ponta dos pés, a pá bate no alto do topete e o ventilador para seco, com uma pá apoiada no topete, e ele segue sério.
script.gag_without_sound: o ventilador girando para de uma vez com a pá encostada no topete, e o topete nem mexe

location.place: lanchonete de esquina com balcão de pão de queijo e ventilador de teto baixo
location.time_of_day: meio da tarde, sol entrando pela porta de enrolar

camera.height: altura do peito, a 3 m, da porta da lanchonete

beats.action: embaixo do ventilador ligado, faz o passo brega: peso de um pé pro outro, quadril pendular, indicador subindo e descendo no tempo
beats.extras: atendente passa pano no balcão, dois fregueses comem pão de queijo nas banquetas

beats.action: no tempo forte sobe na ponta dos pés, e a pá bate no alto do topete e trava o ventilador com uma pá apoiada nele; ele fica ali, sério, encarando a lente

script.end_state: ventilador parado, uma pá apoiada no alto do topete intacto, ele na ponta dos pés, dedo pra cima, cara séria na lente

props.name: ventilador de teto de quatro pás brancas
props.orientation: preso no teto no centro do quadro, pás na horizontal 5 cm acima do topete, girando no sentido horário visto de baixo

storyboard_panels.description: pose de assinatura embaixo do ventilador girando, as pás 5 cm acima do topete
pico do passo brega, quadril para a esquerda do quadro, ventilador borrado de tanto girar
ele na ponta dos pés; a pá encosta no alto do topete e o ventilador trava
ventilador parado, pá nítida apoiada no topete, ele sério na ponta dos pés

script.start_frame: Gersinho no meio da lanchonete, de frente para a câmera, dedo pra cima, mão na barriga; ventilador de teto girando logo acima do topete inteiro; balcão de pão de queijo à esquerda
script.end_frame: ventilador parado, uma pá branca apoiada no alto do topete, ele na ponta dos pés, sério, dedo pra cima

music.trend_sound_hint: brega romântico em alta; corte seco da música no instante em que o ventilador para

script.caption: Calor nenhum desmancha o Gerson. Ventilador nenhum também.
script.originality_note: primeiro gag em que o topete vence uma máquina em movimento; mecanismo de rigidez (para o objeto), não de 'não caber'. Lugar novo: lanchonete mineira.
script.risks: o modelo dobrar a pá ou amassar o topete; o ventilador seguir girando através do topete; ventilador reaparecer girando no último segundo. Conferir painel 3 e o end frame (pá parada nítida, sem borrão).

en.gag_sentence: In a Belo Horizonte corner snack bar he does his signature brega step under a spinning ceiling fan until he rises onto his toes and the top of his rigid pompadour stops the fan dead, one blade resting on it.
en.location: a small corner snack bar (lanchonete) in a working-class Belo Horizonte neighborhood: white tiled walls, a glass counter with a tray of cheese buns, a low ceiling with one white four-blade ceiling fan, afternoon sun coming through a rolled-up steel shop door
en.location_map: Frame-left: the glass counter with a tray of cheese buns and the attendant behind it. Center: him standing on the tiled floor, the white ceiling fan mounted on the ceiling directly above his head, its blades horizontal 5 cm above the top of the pompadour. Frame-right: two red stools at a wall shelf with two customers. Background: white tiled wall with a menu board without readable text.
en.position: standing on the tiled floor in the center of the room, chest square to the lens, the top of the pompadour 5 cm below the plane of the fan blades
en.signature_pose: left hand flat on his belly, right index finger raised beside his head, feet together, heels on the floor
en.extras_tasks: one attendant behind the counter wipes the glass with a cloth looking down, one customer on a stool bites a cheese bun looking at his phone, one customer on the other stool stirs a small coffee looking at the cup
en.props: exactly one white ceiling fan with four blades, centered above him, spinning clockwise seen from below at a steady speed; the blades sweep a horizontal circle 5 cm above the top of the pompadour
en.hands: He has exactly two hands: left hand flat on his belly, right hand with the index finger raised.

stages.text: He holds the signature pose from the start frame under the spinning ceiling fan; breathing lifts the chest, one slow blink.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens
stages.end_state: same pose, the fan blades spinning 5 cm above the pompadour.

stages.text: Real-time, at 95 BPM: he shifts his weight onto his left foot, heel first, then onto his right foot; his hips sway once to frame-left and once to frame-right on the beat; his raised right index finger moves up and down twice on the beat; his left hand stays flat on his belly; the fan keeps spinning above him.
stages.facing: chest within 30° of the lens while the hips sway, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens
stages.end_state: feet together, heels on the floor, finger raised, the fan spinning.

stages.text: On the strong beat he rises onto the balls of both feet, heels 6 cm off the floor; the top of the pompadour enters the circle of the spinning blades; the next white blade strikes the top edge of the pompadour and the ceiling fan stops dead in one beat, that blade resting on top of the pompadour; the pompadour keeps its outline, rigid as molded resin; he keeps the pose on his toes.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens
stages.end_state: the fan stopped, one white blade resting on the top of the pompadour, he on his toes.

stages.text: Everything holds: the ceiling fan stays stopped with its white blade resting on the top of the pompadour; he stays on his toes and stares into the lens, finger raised. The final frame matches the end frame.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens
stages.end_state: fan stopped, blade resting on the pompadour, deadpan face, finger raised.

en.end_change: the ceiling fan is stopped; one white blade rests on the top of the rigid black pompadour, sharp and still; he stands on the balls of his feet, heels 6 cm off the floor, right index finger raised, deadpan face
en.end_props: the fan stopped, its four blades still, one blade resting on the pompadour
en.props_lock: Exactly one ceiling fan with four white blades: spinning in the first frame, stopped in the last frame with one blade resting on the top of the pompadour.
en.lighting: Warm afternoon sunlight through the open steel door at frame-right plus cool white ceiling tube light, soft shadows, 5000K.
